items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: Well, that was your grandfather then was Julian Monette. / Yes. Julian Monette. That's where my son gets his name from.

ctx.x: Eleanor Roosevelt. Her name is really good. Yes, indeed. And she married—
She married Neville Monette. Neville. No, wait, no, she married—I'm—not Neville, his name was Julian. J-U-L-I-E-N, a hyphen over the E, because I have my mother's marriage license here.
Well, that was your grandfather then was Julian Monette.
